notes: All four arms ran on 2026-10-27 with Claude CLI 2.1.310 and claude-sonnet-5-5 at medium effort, sandboxed (acceptEdits + allowlist), 3 repetitions, rotating arm order. GitButler, Git and Jujutsu ran in earlier batches that day; the AISC arm is the dev build with show COMMIT:PATH, the cross-branch amend, directory selectors, commit --onto BRANCH, move --to NEW --onto BASE, aisc branches, and an agent block that names sync --fetch and says reads can be chained in one call.
Token counts and cost are what the Claude CLI reported, cache reads included; no transcripts or prompts beyond the task files are included.
vc_commands lists the version-control commands the agent ran (tool, arguments, exit code; temporary paths replaced by <tmp>); harness setup probes are excluded. No model text is included.
The jj+skill arm ran in a later batch on the same day with the same CLI and settings; its agents get the harness's own jj policy text plus the pinned onevcat-jj skill, as upstream.
